name: Saag Chicken with Spinach and Spices
steps: Brown the chicken in ghee.
Soften the onion, garlic and ginger with the spices and add the blended spinach.
Return the chicken, stir in the yogurt and simmer 15 minutes.

name: Chana Masala
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger in oil with the spices.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer 20 minutes.
Finish with cilantro.

name: Red Lentil Dal with Spinach
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger with the spices in oil.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and broth and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in the spinach.

name: Tandoori-Style Chicken Thighs with Cucumber Raita
steps: Marinate the chicken in half the yogurt with spices, garlic, ginger and lemon.
Roast at 425°F for 30 minutes.
Stir the rest of the yogurt with grated cucumber and mint.

name: Shrimp Curry with Coconut Milk
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger with the curry powder.
Add the tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer 8 minutes.
Add the shrimp and spinach for 4 minutes; serve over rice.

name: Cauliflower and Potato Curry (Aloo Gobi)
steps: Soften the onion and spices in oil.
Add the cauliflower, potatoes and tomatoes with a splash of water.
Cover and cook 20 minutes; finish with cilantro.

name: Pad Thai with Shirataki Noodles and Shrimp
steps: Rinse the shirataki well.
Sear the shrimp in oil, scramble in the egg.
Add the noodles, sauce of fish sauce, paste and lime, then sprouts.
Top with peanuts and green onion.

name: Thai Green Curry with Chicken and Vegetables
steps: Fry the curry paste, add the coconut milk and simmer.
Add the chicken and vegetables and cook 15 minutes.
Finish with basil and fish sauce and serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Thai Basil Chicken Stir-Fry
steps: Stir-fry the garlic and chicken in oil.
Add the vegetables, soy sauce, fish sauce and chili.
Fold in the basil and serve over rice.

name: Tom Kha Gai-Style Coconut Chicken Soup
steps: Simmer the broth, lemongrass and ginger 10 minutes.
Add the chicken, mushrooms and coconut milk and cook 12 minutes.
Finish with lime, fish sauce and cilantro.

name: Bibimbap-Style Bowls with Egg and Vegetables
steps: Sauté each vegetable separately with a little sesame oil.
Fry the eggs.
Arrange over rice and top with gochujang and sesame seeds.

name: Korean Chicken Thighs with Gochujang Glaze
steps: Mix the gochujang, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic and sesame oil and coat the chicken.
Roast at 425°F for 28 minutes.
Serve with sautéed bok choy and sesame seeds.

name: Japchae-Style Stir-Fried Vegetables with Beef
steps: Rinse the shirataki and stir-fry with the sliced beef.
Add the vegetables and garlic.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil and top with seeds.

name: Chicken Ramen-Style Noodle Soup with Soy Egg
steps: Simmer the broth with ginger, soy sauce and mushrooms.
Poach the chicken in it, then slice.
Boil the soba and eggs separately.
Assemble bowls with bok choy, egg, chicken and green onion.

name: Chicken Katsu-Style Baked Cutlets with Cabbage
steps: Coat the pounded chicken in egg then almond flour and parmesan and bake on an oiled tray at 425°F for 18 minutes.
Shred the cabbage with vinegar and sesame oil.
Serve with a quick sauce of paste thinned with vinegar.

name: Salmon Sushi Bowls with Cucumber and Avocado
steps: Season the rice with the vinegar.
Top with salmon, cucumber, avocado, shredded nori and sesame seeds.
Serve with soy sauce.

name: Edamame Miso Soup with Spinach
steps: Simmer the broth, edamame and tofu 5 minutes.
Add the spinach.
Whisk in the miso off the heat and top with green onion.

name: Vietnamese Banh Mi Bowls with Pork
steps: Brown the pork with garlic and fish sauce.
Quick-pickle the carrot and daikon in lime.
Serve over rice with cucumber, cilantro and jalapeno.

name: Vietnamese Chicken Pho-Style Soup
steps: Simmer the broth with ginger, onion, star anise and chicken 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken.
Serve over rinsed shirataki with sprouts, basil, lime and jalapeno.

name: Summer Rolls with Shrimp and Peanut Dip
steps: Poach and halve the shrimp.
Wrap with lettuce, cucumber, carrot, mint and cabbage in large leaves.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce and lime into a dip.

name: Lemongrass Pork Meatballs with Lettuce Wraps
steps: Mix the pork with minced lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce and green onion and shape meatballs.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.
Serve in lettuce with mint and cucumber.

name: Spicy Tuna Roll Salad with Cucumber
steps: Mix the tuna with sriracha and yogurt.
Toss the cucumber with vinegar and spoon the tuna on top.
Add avocado, nori and sesame.

name: Sesame Ginger Salmon with Bok Choy
steps: Brush the salmon with soy sauce, ginger, garlic and sesame oil and bake at 400°F for 12 minutes.
Sauté the bok choy and serve with seeds.

name: Hot and Sweet Tofu with Broccoli
steps: Crisp the cubed tofu in oil.
Stir-fry the broccoli and garlic.
Add the sriracha, soy sauce, vinegar and arrowroot slurry and toss.

name: Coconut Shrimp Soup with Zucchini Noodles
steps: Fry the curry paste and add the coconut milk and broth.
Simmer 5 minutes, add the shrimp for 3.
Stir in the zucchini noodles, lime and cilantro.

name: Egg Roll in a Bowl with Ground Chicken
steps: Brown the chicken with garlic and ginger in oil.
Add the slaw mix and soy sauce and cook 6 minutes.
Finish with sesame oil and green onion.

name: Chicken Shawarma Bowls with Garlic Yogurt
steps: Marinate the chicken in spices, garlic, lemon and oil and roast at 425°F for 20 minutes; slice.
Stir the yogurt with garlic and lemon.
Serve over quinoa with cucumber, tomato and parsley.

name: Lamb Kofta with Tahini Sauce
steps: Mix the lamb with parsley, onion and spices and shape on skewers.
Grill 10 to 12 minutes.
Whisk the tahini with lemon and a little water and serve with cucumber and tomato.

name: Shakshuka-Style Baked Eggs with Chickpeas and Spinach
steps: Soften the onion in oil with the spices and harissa.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer 8 minutes with the spinach.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until set.

name: Mujaddara-Style Lentils and Rice with Caramelized Onions
steps: Cook the onions slowly in oil until deep golden.
Combine the cooked lentils and rice with half the onions and the cumin.
Top with the rest of the onions and serve with yogurt and parsley.

name: Chicken and Chickpea Tagine
steps: Brown the chicken, then soften the onion and garlic with the spices.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and olives and simmer covered 35 minutes.
Finish with cilantro.

name: Stuffed Grape-Leaf-Style Cabbage with Rice and Herbs
steps: Blanch the cabbage leaves.
Mix the rice, herbs, onion, lemon and paste; roll in the leaves.
Pack in a pot with oil and water and simmer 35 minutes.

name: Greek Lemon Chicken Soup (Avgolemono)
steps: Simmer the chicken in the broth; shred it and cook the rice in the broth.
Whisk the eggs with lemon and temper with hot broth.
Stir back in off the heat and add dill.

name: Spanakopita-Style Spinach and Feta Egg Bake
steps: Sauté the onion, garlic and spinach in oil.
Mix with the eggs, feta and dill and pour into a dish.
Bake at 375°F for 28 to 30 minutes.

name: Greek Chicken Souvlaki Plate with Lemon Potatoes
steps: Marinate the chicken in lemon, oregano, garlic and oil; skewer and grill.
Roast the potatoes in lemon and oil.
Serve with cucumber yogurt.

name: Moussaka-Style Eggplant and Turkey Bake
steps: Roast the sliced eggplant.
Brown the turkey with onion, garlic and cinnamon and add the tomatoes.
Layer with the eggplant and top with yogurt whisked with egg and parmesan.
Bake at 375°F for 35 minutes.

name: Jamaican Jerk Chicken with Pineapple Slaw
steps: Blend the spices, garlic, ginger, lime and soy sauce and coat the chicken.
Roast at 425°F for 30 to 35 minutes.
Toss the cabbage with pineapple, lime and cilantro.

name: Caribbean Rice and Peas with Coconut
steps: Simmer the beans with the garlic, thyme and coconut milk.
Fold in the cooked rice and green onion and heat through.

name: Cuban Black Beans and Rice Bowls
steps: Soften the onion, pepper and garlic in oil with the spices.
Add the beans and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve over rice with lime and cilantro.

name: Ropa Vieja-Style Shredded Beef
steps: Simmer the beef in water until tender and shred.
Cook the onion, pepper and garlic in the sauce with spices.
Add the beef and olives and serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Peruvian-Style Roasted Chicken with Green Sauce
steps: Rub the chicken with spices, garlic, lime and oil and roast at 425°F for 40 minutes.
Blend the cilantro, jalapeno, yogurt and a little lime into a green sauce.

name: Argentinian Beef Empanada Filling Bowls
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and spices.
Fold in the chopped olives and sliced boiled egg.
Serve over rice.

name: Brazilian Feijoada-Style Black Bean Stew
steps: Brown the sausage and pork with the onion and garlic.
Add the beans, bay, broth and orange and simmer 45 minutes.
Serve with sautéed collards.

name: Cuban Picadillo over Cauliflower Rice
steps: Brown the beef with the onion, pepper and garlic.
Add the sauce, olives, capers and cumin and simmer 12 minutes.
Serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Moroccan Chickpea and Carrot Salad
steps: Grate the carrots and toss with chickpeas, lemon, oil, cumin and harissa.
Top with parsley and feta.

name: Baba Ganoush with Vegetable Sticks
steps: Roast the eggplant until collapsed, scoop out the flesh.
Blend with tahini, lemon, garlic and oil.
Serve with the vegetable sticks.

name: Za'atar Roasted Chicken with Cauliflower
steps: Toss the chicken and cauliflower with oil, za'atar and salt.
Roast at 425°F for 35 minutes.
Serve with lemon yogurt.

name: Turkish-Style Red Lentil Soup
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in oil with the spices.
Add the lentils and broth and simmer 22 minutes.
Blend and finish with lemon.

name: Egg and Sausage Breakfast Tacos on Corn Tortillas
steps: Brown the sausage and scramble in the eggs.
Warm the tortillas and fill.
Top with cheddar, salsa and avocado.

name: Ham and Spinach Quiche Cups
steps: Divide the ham, spinach and Swiss among six greased cups.
Pour in the eggs whisked with milk and nutmeg.
Bake at 350°F for 20 to 22 minutes.

name: Peanut Butter Chia Breakfast Cookies
steps: Mash the banana and mix everything.
Scoop ten cookies onto a tray.
Bake at 350°F for 12 minutes.

name: Cottage Cheese Egg Scramble with Chives
steps: Scramble the eggs in butter and fold in the cottage cheese.
Finish with chives and pepper.

name: Apple Cheddar Oatmeal
steps: Simmer the oats in water with the diced apple.
Top with cheddar and cinnamon.

name: Greek Yogurt Pancake Stack with Peaches
steps: Whisk the yogurt, eggs and vanilla; fold in the oat flour and baking powder.
Cook small pancakes in butter.
Stack with sliced peaches.

name: Egg and Veggie Breakfast Quesadilla with Black Beans
steps: Scramble the eggs with the pepper.
Fill the tortillas with eggs, beans and cheddar and crisp in a pan.
Serve with salsa.

name: Banana Walnut Baked Oatmeal Cups
steps: Mash the banana and mix with the eggs, milk, oats, cinnamon and baking powder.
Fold in the walnuts and fill muffin cups.
Bake at 350°F for 20 to 22 minutes.

name: Turkey Bacon Wrapped Egg Muffins
steps: Line six muffin cups with turkey bacon.
Fill with spinach, egg and cheddar.
Bake at 375°F for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Sweet Potato Hash Browns
steps: Grate the sweet potato and onion and mix with the egg and seasonings.
Pan-fry thin patties in oil, 5 to 6 minutes a side.

name: Creamy Cauliflower Mac, Stovetop
steps: Steam the cauliflower florets until tender.
Warm the milk, cream cheese and mustard, melt in the cheddar and fold in the cauliflower.

name: Loaded Cauliflower Bake with Bacon and Chives
steps: Steam the cauliflower and mix with the yogurt, cheddar and garlic powder.
Top with bacon and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes; finish with chives.

name: Garlic Parmesan Roasted Cabbage Wedges
steps: Brush the wedges with oil and garlic.
Roast at 425°F for 30 minutes and top with parmesan.

name: Roasted Squash with Pecans and Cinnamon
steps: Roast the squash with butter, cinnamon and thyme at 400°F for 30 minutes.
Top with pecans.

name: Sauteed Mushrooms with Garlic and Thyme
steps: Brown the mushrooms in butter and oil.
Add the garlic and thyme and finish with parsley.

name: Cilantro Lime Black Beans
steps: Warm the beans with garlic, cumin and oil.
Finish with lime and cilantro.

name: Italian Roasted Broccoli with Sun-Dried Tomatoes
steps: Roast the broccoli with oil and garlic at 425°F for 18 minutes.
Toss with the tomatoes and parmesan.

name: Greek Lemon Roasted Potatoes and Green Beans
steps: Toss everything with lemon, oil, oregano and garlic.
Roast at 425°F for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: Skillet Zucchini and Corn with Basil
steps: Sauté the zucchini and corn in oil with garlic.
Finish with basil and parmesan.

name: Cinnamon Roasted Chickpeas Snack
steps: Dry the chickpeas and toss with oil.
Roast at 400°F for 25 minutes and toss with cinnamon and sweetener.

name: Mini Caprese Skewers with Balsamic
steps: Thread the mozzarella, tomato and basil.
Drizzle with balsamic.

name: Turkey Pepperoni-Style Zucchini Pizza Bites
steps: Slice the zucchini into thick rounds.
Top with marinara, mozzarella and sausage.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.

name: Avocado Egg Salad Boats
steps: Hard-boil and chop the eggs.
Mix with yogurt, mustard and chives.
Fill the avocado halves.

name: Shrimp and Cucumber Rounds with Dill Cream Cheese
steps: Poach the shrimp and chill.
Spread the cucumber rounds with cream cheese mixed with dill and lemon.
Top with shrimp.

name: Spicy Edamame Hummus
steps: Blend the edamame with tahini, lemon, garlic, sriracha and oil.
Serve with cucumber.

name: Raspberry Almond Thumbprint Cookies
steps: Mix the almond flour, egg, butter, vanilla and sweetener and roll twelve balls.
Press a thumbprint into each and fill with mashed raspberries stirred with chia.
Bake at 350°F for 12 minutes.

name: Dark Chocolate Dipped Almond Butter Bites
steps: Mix the almond butter, oats, chia and vanilla and roll into bites.
Dip in melted chocolate and chill.

name: Lemon Poppy Seed Yogurt Cups
steps: Stir the yogurt with lemon, chia, vanilla and sweetener.
Spoon into cups and top with blueberries.

name: Spiced Poached Pears
steps: Simmer the whole peeled pears in the spiced water 20 to 25 minutes.
Serve with a spoon of the poaching liquid.

name: Cherry Almond Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk the chia, almond milk, almond butter and vanilla; chill 4 hours.
Top with cherries.

name: Tahini Chocolate Swirl Yogurt Bark
steps: Spread the sweetened yogurt on a tray and swirl in the tahini.
Drizzle with melted chocolate and pistachios.
Freeze 3 hours and break up.

name: Pumpkin Cheesecake Mousse Cups
steps: Whip the cream cheese, pumpkin, yogurt, spice, vanilla and sweetener.
Spoon into cups, chill and top with pecans.

name: Iced Chai Latte with Almond Milk
steps: Warm the almond milk with the spices and steep the tea.
Chill and serve over ice.

name: Iced Green Tea Frappe with Almond Milk
steps: Blend the chilled tea, almond milk, sweetener and vanilla with ice.

name: Cherry Vanilla Kefir Smoothie
steps: Blend everything until smooth.

name: Orange Cream Protein Smoothie
steps: Blend everything with ice.

name: Turkey Reuben Sandwich on Rye
steps: Layer the turkey, Swiss and sauerkraut on mustard-spread rye.
Grill in butter until golden and melted.

name: Chicken Avocado Club Wrap
steps: Layer the chicken, avocado, bacon, tomato and lettuce in the tortillas.
Roll and halve.

name: Open-Faced Egg and Avocado Toast with Tomato
steps: Toast the bread and spread with mashed avocado.
Top with sliced tomato and fried egg and pepper flakes.

name: Italian Sub in a Lettuce Boat
steps: Fill the romaine leaves with turkey, ham, mozzarella, tomato and onion.
Dress with vinegar and oil.

name: Pulled Chicken Sliders on Small Buns
steps: Poach and shred the chicken and toss with a sauce of paste, vinegar and paprika.
Mix the slaw with the yogurt.
Fill the small buns.

name: Mediterranean Tuna Pita with Olives and Cucumber
steps: Mix the tuna with olives, cucumber, onion, lemon and oil.
Stuff the pitas.

name: Cheesy Spinach Mushroom Quesadilla
steps: Sauté the mushrooms, spinach and garlic.
Fill the tortillas with the vegetables and cheese and crisp in a pan.

name: Smoked Salmon Bagel Thins with Cucumber
steps: Split and toast the bagel.
Spread with cream cheese and layer salmon, cucumber, capers and dill.

name: Barbecue Chicken Salad Sandwich Cups
steps: Shred the chicken and mix with paste, vinegar, celery, onion and yogurt.
Spoon into lettuce cups.

name: Steak and Cheese Stuffed Mushrooms
steps: Sauté the sliced steak, onion and pepper.
Fill the mushroom caps, top with Swiss and bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.

name: BBQ Chicken Salad with Corn and Black Beans
steps: Grill the chicken with a paste and vinegar rub; slice.
Arrange the romaine, beans, corn and tomatoes.
Top with chicken, avocado and a spoon of yogurt.

name: Greek Chickpea Salad with Feta
steps: Toss everything together and let stand 15 minutes.

name: Broccoli Cranberry Salad with Yogurt Dressing
steps: Chop the broccoli finely.
Mix the yogurt and vinegar and toss with the broccoli, cranberries, seeds and onion.
Top with crumbled bacon.

name: Asian Slaw with Peanut-Lime Dressing and Grilled Chicken
steps: Grill and slice the chicken.
Whisk the peanut butter, lime, soy sauce and ginger.
Toss with the slaw, edamame and cilantro and top with chicken.

name: Roasted Carrot and Arugula Salad with Goat Cheese
steps: Roast the carrots with half the oil at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Toss with arugula, balsamic and the rest of the oil and top with goat cheese and walnuts.

name: Mexican Chopped Salad with Lime Dressing
steps: Chop and combine everything.
Dress with lime and oil.

name: Italian Sausage and Kale Soup
steps: Brown the sausage with the onion and garlic.
Add the broth and beans and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the kale and top with parmesan.

name: Roasted Red Pepper and Tomato Soup
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in oil.
Add the peppers, tomatoes and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend with the basil.

name: Cabbage and Bean Soup with Smoked Turkey
steps: Soften the onion and carrot, add the cabbage.
Add the broth, beans, turkey and thyme and simmer 25 minutes.

name: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Soup
steps: Soften the onion with the spices.
Add the sweet potato, beans and broth and simmer 22 minutes.
Finish with lime.

name: Creamy Chicken and Wild Rice Casserole
steps: Combine the cooked rice, chicken, mushrooms, onion, thyme and milk in a dish.
Top with cheddar and bake at 375°F for 35 minutes.

name: Turkey Burgers Stuffed with Spinach and Feta
steps: Wilt the spinach and mix with feta and garlic.
Form patties around the filling.
Grill 6 to 7 minutes a side and serve in lettuce.

name: Sheet Pan Chicken Thighs with Sweet Potato and Broccoli
steps: Toss everything on a tray with oil and spices.
Roast at 425°F for 35 minutes.

name: Lemon Dill Chicken Meatballs with Orzo-Style Quinoa
steps: Mix the chicken, egg, dill, half the lemon, garlic and oat bran and shape meatballs.
Bake at 400°F for 18 minutes.
Fold the spinach and rest of the lemon into warm quinoa and serve.

name: Garlic Herb Pork Loin Roast with Carrots
steps: Rub the pork with garlic, herbs, mustard and oil.
Roast on the carrots at 400°F for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: Beef and Mushroom Skillet with Cauliflower Mash
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and mushrooms; thicken the broth with arrowroot.
Boil and mash the cauliflower with butter.
Serve the beef over the mash.
